claim: Petition to the county board of equalization must be filed on or before July 1st of the year of the assessment, or within a time limit of up to 60 days adopted by the county legislative authority, whichever is later.
The board of equalization may waive the filing deadline for good cause if the petition is filed within a reasonable time after the deadline.
An appeal may go directly to the state board of tax appeals if the assessor, the owner, and a majority of the county board of equalization agree.
All property must be valued at 100 percent of its true and fair value in money and assessed on the same basis unless specifically provided otherwise by law.

The REET is the obligation of the seller; the Department of Revenue may enforce it by action of debt against the seller or by foreclosure in the manner of mortgages.
